Here are a handful of punchy, memorable names that mix the buzz of AI with the entrepreneurial spirit of side‑hustles:

| # | Newsletter Title | Why it works |
|---|------------------|--------------|
| 1 | **“AI Hustle Hub”** | Straight‑forward, tells readers it’s a launchpad for AI‑powered side gigs. |
| 2 | **“Machine‑Made Money”** | Plays on the classic “machine” theme, highlighting money‑making potential. |
| 3 | **“Side‑Gig GPT”** | Short, tech‑savvy, and instantly ties to the famous AI model. |
| 4 | **“Neuron‑Net Sidebars”** | Wordplay on neural networks + “sidebars” (sub‑projects). |
| 5 | **“Autonomous Income”** | Suggests automation + earning—good for a professional tone. |
| 6 | **“Zero‑to‑Profit AI”** | Emphasises rapid growth, appealing to beginner side‑hunters. |
| 7 | **“AI Side‑Chore”** | A whimsical twist on “side hustle”, adding "chore" for “automation”. |
| 8 | **“Silicon Side‑Ways”** | Word‑play on “sideways” + silicon, perfect for tech‑centric readers. |

Pick one that matches your brand voice—house‑styled, playful, or corporate—and you’ll have a headline that clicks with your audience!
